title: Integrated Fanmade OST
description: A collection of soundtracks that I felt fit the game. Includes fanmade ones as well as ones from other games.
body:
### Description
This resourcepack adds a variety of new soundtracks into the game. Currently, the pack contains nine tracks overall; four Overworld tracks, two Nether tracks, and three End tracks. **NONE** of the soundtracks were created by me, and credit to all tracks can be found below. This resourcepack also comes with built-in support for "[Now Playing](https://modrinth.com/mod/now-playing)"!

### Credits / Overworld
- Steelman - Far Lands
- Jellyraymen - Solace
- C418 - Équinoxe
- Amos Roddy - Lilypad

### Credits / Nether
- Jellyraymen - Ballad of Mirrors
- Andrew Prahlow - End Times

### Credits / End
- Oh Eight - The Great Abyss
- Jellyraymen - Undefined
- Andrew Prahlow - Final Voyage

### Other Info
This resourcepack will be updated periodically as I find more soundtracks to put into it.
